# Apicurio Registry

> Apicurio Registry is an open source (Apache 2.0) schema registry and API registry, and a CNCF Sandbox project. It stores, versions, validates and governs Avro, Protobuf and JSON Schema schemas, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI and GraphQL definitions, and AI artifacts such as A2A agent cards, MCP tools, prompt templates and model schemas. It implements the Confluent Schema Registry API (v7 and v8) and ships Kafka SerDes and Kafka Connect converters. Latest release: {{ registry_release.tag_name | remove_first: "v" }}.
